verdict.rationale: Automatic sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation is a fair question for a payments and invoicing platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any tax calculation or collection capability. Invoices, multi-currency acceptance, FX rates and payment splitting are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
